what: On fixtures/frozen_attn_scores.json (non-flat s), for p=softmax(β·s) and β>0: dH/dβ = −β Var_p(s) and d(Σp²)/dβ = 2 Cov_p(p,s). Interval enclosures of Var and Cov are strictly positive on the β-grid and midpoints, so H and PR are strictly decreasing on (0,∞) for this fixture.
scope: frozen GPTTiny layer-0/head-0 last-query scores at seed=0; this non-flat fixture only; NOT trained dynamics; grid enclosure of H/PR is CERT-ml-beta-softmax
falsifier_list: flat s → Var and Cov not strictly positive
note: Local fixture cert (not ledger-minted). Complements CERT-ml-beta-softmax. The identities dH/dβ=−β Var and majorization⇒PR↓ are classical (Mattei & Loureiro arXiv:2602.14862 Prop. 2; Dabah & Tirer ICML 2025). This cert encloses their sign on the fixture; it does not claim to derive them.
